title: "2 · Elements of Deep Learning"
code-tools: false

---

Loss functions for regression and classification, the zoo of architectures, gradient descent with mini-batches, iterations and epochs, and what a well-trained network is. A neural network learns the probability distribution of its training data; the factors behind today's deep learning. The first example: MNIST digit classification as non-linear function fitting, with the categorical cross-entropy.
